look: Crimson Whisperer, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Whisperers family (GKOM-A cultists (Weaververse "Whisperers"), D&D cult fanatics archetype reimagined for Adams Haven): cult queen in a red-crystal crown and elegant dark-crimson regalia, fully covered. Family anatomy: hooded human GKOM-A cultists with black-veined hands, cracked-marble skin and red-tinged energy. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are crimson crystal. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, vivid sweeping shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
